[1/1] Plan pipe-silencing hardening and single-lstat special check

impact_assessment.why: Reforge stage-6 review recorded two findings: main() catches only BrokenPipeError so Windows closed-pipe writes (OSError EINVAL) and shutdown-flush noise still leak, and _is_special pays up to four extra stat() calls per candidate entry
impact_assessment.benefits: Piped runs like  exit quietly on Windows and POSIX alike; directory enumeration drops from up to five stats per file to two (is_symlink + one lstat)
impact_assessment.risks: contract: BrokenPipe exit code stays 0 and POSIX behavior unchanged; dependency: stat module is stdlib-only; concurrency: none, single-threaded scan; state: no file writes involved
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests pin EINVAL silencing and lstat-based special detection; ADR-010 records the decisions; full 4-gate check before commit
